sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 26886 of 2021
Applicant :- Girendra Singh And 2 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajeev Malviya
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash impugned
summoning order dated 21.09.2021 as well as entire proceedings of Complaint Case No. 2465 of
2019 (Smt. Madhu Vs. Girendra Singh and others), under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 Ipc and
Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Khairgarh, District Firozabad, pending in the court of Additional
Civil Judge (Jr. Div.)/Judicial Magistrate, Court No.05, Firozabad.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text:
Additional
Civil Judge (Jr. Div.)/Judicial Magistrate, Court No.05, Firozabad
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Girendra Singh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicants has made a statement at the Bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press other prayers made in the instant application and states that the applicants are ready to appear before the court below and seek their bail and that their release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
4.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA states that he has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants for not pressing the other prayers made in the instant application.

5. In view of the above, in case the applicants appear before the court below within four weeks from today and seek bail, their release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
6.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed off.
